name: Kanban Task Management Platform
tagline: Real-time, drag-and-drop collaborative Kanban board with state-driven column pipelines.
description: Interactive workflow organization platform engineered to coordinate multi-stage project lifecycles, sprint progress, and task prioritization using fluid UI drag-and-drop interactions and persistent RESTful backend storage.
problem: Agile software and product teams struggle with clunky, overloaded project management tools that lack responsive visual layout updates, drag-and-drop clarity, and simple state synchronization.
solution: Engineered an agile task management board with optimized column state pipelines (Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done), dynamic task re-ordering, subtask progress tracking, and resilient API endpoints for seamless data persistence.
metrics_and_highlights: Implemented fluid drag-and-drop task interactions across stages with instant optimistic UI state updates.
Engineered decoupled client-server architecture with REST endpoints handling board creation, column mutations, and card lifecycle events.
Integrated subtask completion tracking, tag-based categorization, and priority-level indicators (Low, Medium, High, Urgent).
Optimized client rendering speeds with modern bundler tooling (Vite + Fast HMR).

workflow_pipeline: Dynamic board and column creation with customizable status workflows
Interactive card re-ordering and cross-column transitions with drag-and-drop state persistence
Task detail modals featuring subtask checklists, due-date pickers, and description markdown
backend_and_data_layer: RESTful API architecture handling granular board, column, and task CRUD operations
Structured NoSQL data models maintaining card sorting order indices and board memberships
Centralized error handling and schema validation for state mutations

frontend: HTML5 Drag and Drop / DnD Kit
